text:
harper: Postmortem follow-up for PM-2026-09 (memory thrash leading to degraded throughput). Consolidated action items + owner proposals below. Please ack or propose swaps within 48h.

Actions:
1) Per-shard memory limits + eviction tuning (JIRA-8301) - proposed owner: zoe - ETA 5 business days
2) Canary rollout gating + automated rollback (JIRA-8302) - proposed owner: mike + eng-deploy (Consulted) - ETA 7 days
3) Postmortem recurrence automation (internal task) - proposed owner: harper - ETA 3 days
4) Runbook update + tabletop test (JIRA-8303) - proposed owner: lia - ETA 4 days
5) Investigation into nightly GC spikes (JIRA-8304) - proposed owner: zoe - ETA 3 business days

zoe: Ack on 8301 and 8304. I've already grabbed heap snapshots from the last three events and will attach to tickets. Starting repro in staging tonight.

mike: I'll take 8302. Request eng-deploy be listed as Consulted. Suggested RACI for 8302: Mike (R), eng-deploy (C), Harper (A), Zoe (I). I'll open a subtask for the rollback smoke test.

lia: I'll own 8303. Plan: add a recurrence-checkbox to the PM template + a checklist item requiring a "remediation-verification: SHA=<sha> smoke=<id> traces=<link>" before close. Drafting PR to ops-runbooks now.

infra-bot: Created subtask JIRA-8302.1 for rollback harness: https://jira.redwood.local/browse/JIRA-8302.1

harper: Two process asks: a) any cross-team remediation must be split into subtasks with explicit RACI on each subtask, b) require a verification comment formatted exactly as: "remediation-verification: SHA=<sha> smoke=<id> traces=<link>" before PM close.

zoe: +1 on subtasks. For 8301 I'll push a small mitigation (lower shard caps + eviction jitter) behind feature flags so we can flip quickly if we see regressions. Will add tests and metrics dashboards.

mike: For 8302 I'll include healthcheck metrics (p99, error-rate) that will gate promotion. Adding canary duration default 30m and failure criteria to the ticket.

lia: PR: https://github.com/redwood/ops-runbooks/pull/1033 - adds recurrence checkbox + verification requirement to template. Also added a short tabletop script.

harper: If anyone accepts an owner here, please update the Jira with the RACI and the estimated due date. I'll close owner assignment in 48h unless someone requests a swap.

zoe: I'll attach traces and initial findings to JIRA-8304 by EOD tomorrow. If staging repro fails, I'll schedule a quick 30m with infra.

mike: Opening subtask for rollback tests now and pinging eng-deploy. Will include partial rollout testcases.

harper: Final note: to prevent PM churn, add a weekly recurrence-review card for any PM flagged as "recurrence-candidate" (>2 events). Lia I'll need you to wire that automation to the board.

lia: Will do. Scheduling weekly slot and adding automation to the board.

infra-bot: Recurrence-review card scheduled: weekly Fri 08:00 UTC.

harper: Thanks. Closing thread for owner assignments in 48h.
